observer: Assistant visual inspection; not human ratings
exposure: Creator references, qualification/calibration results and all three completed held-out matched blocks are known. This crossed seed-42 private mapping has not been displayed. All eighteen anonymous sparse grids and both creator references were inspected before this record. Prior depictions may be recognizable; this is method-blinded, not independent double-blind human review. No held-out numerical similarity scores computed.
sampling: 21 chronological 4-fps samples per Cxx-frames.jpg, 320-pixel-wide cells in a 5x5 grid; 378 candidate samples total with four black padding cells per grid. All-124-frame and unchanged-waveform inspection required for every candidate before method unblinding.
inference_before_unblinding: Sully C08/C09/C18 retain vest with differing head designs; six others omit it and retain coarse creator-like features. Some books start held tilted above table; others are already on table with hand/edge contact. Several later hand movements need separation from set-down or earlier contact. Combat endings vary between lowered gloves and retained guard; broad activity episodes are not exact punch counts. No method attribution, sound judgment or overall winner.
